picks.editorial_note: MIT's Barzilay and Collins won the 2026 Pritzker Prize for pioneering AI-enabled antibiotic discovery, a landmark recognition of deep learning's real-world impact on drug discovery amid rising antibiotic resistance.
picks.title: Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins win Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence for work in AI-enabled antibiotic discovery

picks.editorial_note: A Cambridge team's AI-guided vaccine design achieved complete protection against diverse bird flu variants in animal trials, demonstrating AI's potential to accelerate defenses against emerging pandemic threats.
picks.title: Scientists are using AI to develop superior vaccines against viruses threatening global health

picks.editorial_note: Nebraska will lead cybersecurity for FabAID, a $24.5 million NSF national infrastructure project for AI-driven science, underscoring the federal government's major investment in secure AI research infrastructure.
picks.title: University to lead cybersecurity for national Fabric for AI-Driven Science project

picks.editorial_note: Boston University joined a $39.5 million ARPA-H consortium with Philips, Johns Hopkins, and Weill Cornell to build AI-enabled robotic catheters for remote stroke treatment, a high-value industry-academia-government collaboration with direct clinical stakes.
picks.title: Brink Bites: Robotic Stroke Surgery, Curbing Junk Food Sales, and American Attitudes On Data Center Construction

picks.editorial_note: HKUST and HSBC signed a strategic framework to advance AI and financial innovation through a new joint institute, deepening a near three-decade academic-industry relationship in a major financial hub.
picks.title: HKUST and HSBC Forge Strategic Partnership to Advance AI, Emerging Technologies and Financial Innovation
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: The DOE's release of 'Genesis Agent Skills,' developed with Fermilab, signals how the federal Genesis Mission is operationalizing agentic AI to accelerate scientific machine-learning workflows nationally.
picks.title: ‘Genesis Agent Skills’ release to support innovation across the Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: A Case Western-led, NIH-funded multi-institutional team will use AI alongside satellite imaging and health data to probe environmental drivers of Alzheimer's and dementia, pairing large-scale data science with a major public health question.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve-led team to study how the environment contributes to Alzheimer’s and dementia | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: Google.org funding will let ANU modernize a widely used fusion simulation tool with AI, illustrating how major tech philanthropy is accelerating progress toward practical fusion energy.
picks.title: ANU receives Google funding to boost fusion energy research with AI

picks.editorial_note: A Georgetown economist's analysis of SpaceX's and Anthropic's massive equity pledges—including up to $100 billion from Anthropic—spotlights an emerging policy debate over how AI windfalls should be distributed to the public.
picks.title: Billions in SpaceX, Anthropic Stock Pledged to the Public. Who Benefits? - Georgetown University

picks.editorial_note: Imperial College academics engaged with NVIDIA at GTC Berlin on next-generation AI, highlighting an established compute-infrastructure partnership that shapes the university's AI research capacity.
picks.title: Imperial experts explore the next generation of AI at NVIDIA GTC Berlin
